definitions.explanation: Television and radio operated by private companies and funded by advertising, as distinguished from public broadcasting. An abbreviation of {民間|みんかん}{放送|ほうそう}.

examples.japanese: {民放|みんぽう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watch a drama on a commercial channel.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{民放|みんぽう}{各局|かっきょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{報|ほう}じられた→報じる：17193_houjiru⟧。
examples.english: The news was reported on every commercial channel.

examples.japanese: {民放|みんぽう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{広告収入|こうこくしゅうにゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{成|な}り{立|た}っている→成り立つ：07921_naritatsu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{視聴率|しちょうりつ}→視聴率：08381_shichouritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}する→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧。
examples.english: Because commercial broadcasters rely on advertising revenue, they place great importance on ratings.

notes:
Abbreviation of ⟦{民間|みんかん}→民間：13260_minkan⟧⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧ (private broadcasting). Refers to TV and radio stations run by private companies and funded by advertising rather than viewer fees.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {民放|みんぽう}{各局|かっきょく}: all the commercial channels
- {民放|みんぽう}⟦キー→キー：10869_kii⟧⟦{局|きょく}→局：02687_kyoku⟧: the major commercial networks
- {民放|みんぽう}⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧: commercial television

SIMILAR WORDS:
- NHK: Japan's public broadcaster — funded by viewer fees, not advertising
- {公共放送|こうきょうほうそう}: public broadcasting — the contrasting category to {民放|みんぽう}
